tasks.title: Implement the guarded Windows operator foundation
acceptance: Create localpilot/operator.py with an OperationRisk enum containing READ_ONLY, REVERSIBLE, and DESTRUCTIVE
Create a CommandSpec dataclass that stores argv as a list of strings, the operation risk, and a timeout; do not accept shell command strings
Create a CommandRunner that invokes subprocess.run with the argv list and shell=False, captures stdout/stderr, applies the timeout, and returns a structured result
Destructive operations must be denied unless an explicit approval callback returns true; no approval callback means destructive operations are denied
Read-only and reversible operations may run through the same policy layer without destructive approval

Create tests/test_operator.py proving shell metacharacters remain literal arguments and cannot become a second command, destructive commands are refused without approval, and a harmless approved command can run
Keep this task to the operator foundation only; do not yet wire command execution into the main agent
Do not weaken the existing stable/developer/candidate separation or autonomous-editing path protections
